verdict.rationale: Ramp's core product (expense management, cards, bill pay, etc.) is closed-source SaaS with no evidence of an open license; however, the Ramp CLI is published as open source on GitHub (ramp-public/ramp-cli) with a public README, giving AI-native users at least one readable, openly-licensed component of the ecosystem. missing for 10: no open license on the core platform/backend, no evidence of an explicit OSS license file for the CLI, no independent confirmation of license terms.
